CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_access_scope()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare c text; v text;
begin
  c := public.neo_ctx_read('scope');
  if c is not null then return substr(c,2); end if;
  SELECT coalesce(
    (SELECT s.lvl FROM (
       SELECT coalesce(r.access_scope, public.role_scope_level(r.name)) AS lvl
       FROM public.user_roles ur
       JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
       WHERE ur.user_id = auth.uid()
         AND ur.organization_id = public.current_org_id()
     ) s
     ORDER BY public.scope_rank(s.lvl) DESC
     LIMIT 1),
    'self') into v;
  perform public.neo_ctx_write('scope', 'v'||v);
  return v;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_autopost_txn()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin if TG_TABLE_NAME='pos_orders' then if NEW.status in ('closed','paid','settled','completed','charged-to-room') and (TG_OP='INSERT' or NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status) then if NEW.folio_id is null then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('pos_order',NEW.id,true); else perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('pos_order',NEW.id,true); end if; end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='folio_lines' then if NEW.status='posted' and coalesce(NEW.line_type,'charge')<>'payment' and (TG_OP='INSERT' or NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status) then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('folio_charge',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='payments' then if NEW.status in ('confirmed','completed','paid','succeeded','captured') and (TG_OP='INSERT' or NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status) then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('folio_payment',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='invoices' then if NEW.event_booking_id is null and NEW.status in ('issued','sent','partially_paid','paid','overdue') and (TG_OP='INSERT' or NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status) then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('event_invoice',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='event_bookings' then if coalesce(NEW.deposit_paid,0)>coalesce(OLD.deposit_paid,0) and not exists(select 1 from public.event_payments ep where ep.booking_id=NEW.id and ep.entry_type='deposit' and ep.amount>0) then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('event_deposit',NEW.id,true); end if; if NEW.status in ('completed','closed') and NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('event_earned',NEW.id,true); end if; if NEW.status='cancelled' and NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('event_cancellation',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='delivery_orders' then if NEW.order_status in ('delivered','completed') and NEW.order_status is distinct from OLD.order_status then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('delivery_order',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='guest_laundry_orders' then if NEW.status in ('delivered','completed','closed') and NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status and NEW.folio_id is null and coalesce(NEW.total,0)>0 then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('laundry_order',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_invoices' then if NEW.approved_at is not null and NEW.status in ('approved','matched','partially_paid','paid') and (TG_OP='INSERT' or OLD.approved_at is null or NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status) then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('supplier_invoice',NEW.id,true); end if; elsif TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_payments' then if NEW.status in ('paid','completed','settled') and (TG_OP='INSERT' or NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status) then perform public.neo_finance_post_txn('supplier_payment',NEW.id,true); end if; end if; return NEW; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_branch_in_scope(_branch uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN public.current_access_scope() IN ('organisation','technical') THEN true
    ELSE _branch IS NULL OR _branch = ANY (public.current_branch_ids())
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_kitchen_route_order_item(_order_item uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _r record;
BEGIN
  SELECT oi.organization_id AS org, o.branch_id AS branch, oi.menu_item_id AS menu_item,
         mi.category_id AS category, o.order_type AS order_type, oi.station_id AS persisted
    INTO _r
  FROM public.pos_order_items oi
  JOIN public.pos_orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN public.menu_items mi ON mi.id = oi.menu_item_id
  WHERE oi.id = _order_item;

  IF _r IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('station_id', NULL, 'source', 'missing-order-item', 'missing', true);
  END IF;

  RETURN public.neo_kitchen_resolve_station(_r.org, _r.branch, _r.menu_item, _r.category, _r.order_type, _r.persisted);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_laundry_posting_invariant()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.posting_status = 'posted' AND (NEW.folio_line_id IS NULL OR NEW.folio_id IS NULL)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.finance_posting_receipts r
                      WHERE r.source_module = 'laundry' AND r.source_id = NEW.id
                        AND r.status = 'posted' AND r.journal_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Laundry order cannot be marked posted without a folio charge line or a posted ledger journal';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_laundry_stamp_delivered()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status IN ('delivered','completed') AND NEW.delivered_at IS NULL THEN
    NEW.delivered_at := now();
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_record_posting_receipt(_org uuid, _branch uuid, _module text, _source uuid, _reference text, _status text, _amount numeric, _currency text, _folio_line uuid, _detail text, _error text, _occurred date)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _mod text := _module;
        _key text := public.neo_canonical_posting_module(_module) || ':' || _source::text; _id uuid;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.finance_posting_receipts AS r
    (organization_id, branch_id, source_module, source_id, source_reference, idempotency_key,
     status, amount, currency, folio_line_id, detail, attempts, last_error, requested_by,
     posted_at, occurred_on)
  VALUES (_org, _branch, _mod, _source, _reference, _key, _status, coalesce(_amount,0),
          coalesce(_currency,'KES'), _folio_line, _detail, 1, _error, auth.uid(),
          CASE WHEN _status = 'posted' THEN now() END, _occurred)
  ON CONFLICT (organization_id, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
     SET status = CASE WHEN r.status = 'posted' THEN 'posted' ELSE excluded.status END,
         amount = excluded.amount,
         currency = excluded.currency,
         folio_line_id = coalesce(r.folio_line_id, excluded.folio_line_id),
         detail = excluded.detail,
         attempts = r.attempts + 1,
         last_error = excluded.last_error,
         requested_by = coalesce(excluded.requested_by, r.requested_by),
         posted_at = coalesce(r.posted_at, excluded.posted_at),
         occurred_on = coalesce(r.occurred_on, excluded.occurred_on)
  RETURNING r.id INTO _id;
  RETURN _id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_station_consumption_location(_org uuid, _station uuid, _branch uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT sl.id
  FROM public.station_consumption_stores m
  JOIN public.operational_stations s
    ON s.id = m.station_id
   AND s.organization_id = _org
   AND s.active
  JOIN public.stock_locations sl
    ON sl.id = m.location_id
   AND sl.organization_id = _org
   AND sl.active
   AND NOT COALESCE(sl.is_main, false)
  WHERE m.organization_id = _org
    AND m.station_id = _station
    AND _station IS NOT NULL
    AND s.branch_id IS NOT NULL
    AND s.branch_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _branch
    AND m.branch_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.branch_id
    AND sl.branch_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.branch_id
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

scope: Installed code, schema and trigger inspection only. No delivery, payment, stock movement, invoice acceptance, journal posting or historical retry is invoked.
